description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Sweden Sweden nationwide statutory public holidays for 2026-2027 result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when nationwide statutory list only. Midsummer Eve, Christmas Eve, New Year's Eve, employer, collective-agreement, sector, school, bank and local closures are not inferred; Sunday is already excluded by the weekday baseline.
What it computes: Checks a date against the Saturday-Sunday weekend baseline and exact 2026-2027 authority events.
Example user requests: Sweden: National Day. | Sweden: Midsummer Eve is not statutory.
Inputs: date (date).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2026-06-06"} | {"date":"2026-06-19"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: is_working_day = not an official Saturday/Sunday weekend date and no exact authority event
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/sweden-public-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/sweden-public-working-day.md
name: check_se_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Sweden nationwide statutory public holidays for 2026-2027

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

holiday_policy.description: Swedish statutory public holidays under Lag (1989:253), including date-rule holidays; customary equivalent office closures are not inferred.

is_working_day.description: Monday-Friday with no event in this pinned authority scope.

substitute_day_policy.description: No nationwide substitute-day closure is inferred when a statutory holiday falls on a weekend.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Sweden Working Day
